'''Bales''' is an [[Organization]] operative, renowned for being something of a "smooth operator". Wearing a blue flat-cap and grey blazer, he is far more discreet and inconspicuous than the average [[Suit]]. 

== History ==
[[DeFoe]] was praising of Bales' abilities, stating on one particular mission that a Suit would be far too conspicuous and Bales would be best for the job. {{Source|TCG:LGS-041|LGS-041}}

== Abilities ==
In addition to being sleek and subdued, Bales is strong enough to handle himself and is able to inhibit and restrain his enemies.
=== Spells Utilized ===
*[[Simplemind]]
